besluite.fout: The embedded relative clause runs straight into the main verb ('siek is hoes'), so the reader stumbles.
besluite.rede: A comma closing the relative clause makes the sentence read cleanly on a first pass without changing anything it says.

besluite.fout: Bare verbs as subject ('Praat en sing maak') read woodenly, and 'dieselfde' literally means the identical droplets.
besluite.rede: The proposal says the same thing in natural Afrikaans; 'hy' points to the sick person and the next sentence's 'hulle' still points to the droplets.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb ('dit gebeur', 'n oop venster maak').
besluite.rede: Punctuation fix only, as the AWS 2017 requires.

besluite.fout: The pronoun shifts from 'jy' to 'julle' inside one sentence.
besluite.rede: Changing 'uit 'n beker' (the cup as the source) to 'as jy ... met iemand deel' (the act of sharing) moves the myth being refuted, and sharing with a sick person nearby can involve airborne spread, so the writer must fix the pronoun another way.

besluite.fout: No comma before the concessive clause 'ook al vertel die mens niks'.
besluite.rede: A comma setting off the concessive clause is standard and leaves every word intact.

besluite.fout: 'Die meeste' with the countable noun 'hoes' needs the plural.
besluite.rede: Grammar fix to 'hoeste'; the quantifier 'die meeste' is untouched.

besluite.fout: The cough itself is made the subject that must go to the clinic.
besluite.rede: A real fault, but this is the lesson's instruction on when to go to the clinic, so the writer who owns that checked wording should fix who goes.

besluite.fout: Same fault: the dry cough is the subject that goes to the clinic.
besluite.rede: Same as change 7: a real fault in a health-action instruction, which goes to the writer rather than being reworded here.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses ('slym kom op', 'daar is bloed').
besluite.rede: Punctuation only; the protected wording 'Dikwels kom slym saam met die hoes op' stays word for word.
'Sonder dat hy probeer' is already natural Afrikaans; adding 'dit' is a lateral move.

besluite.fout: 'Hy hou aan ook nadat' runs together and the reader stumbles; it is also unclear what he keeps on with.
besluite.rede: 'Daarmee' points back to drinking the medicine and the comma sets off the 'ook nadat' clause, with no change in meaning.
'Byhou' (keeping up with the doses) and 'volhou' (persevering) say different things about what the clinic does, and the original is acceptable Afrikaans.

besluite.fout: 'Die kind' has no antecedent; no child has been mentioned in the block.
besluite.rede: The proposal gives the reference without adding a fact, and 'hoë koors' stays intact.
'Trek af oor die lyf' is clear in context, and 'versprei dan afwaarts' is longer and stiffer for a Grade 5 reader without being clearly better.

besluite.fout: The phrase 'meestal in 'n mens se longe' hangs loosely in the definition.
besluite.rede: This rewords a glossary definition, and 'aantas' also shifts it from where the disease sits to what it attacks, so it goes to the writer.
